versions.notes:
Critical fix: Dexcom API stale data bug — minutes param changed from 10 to 1440, preventing hours of stale glucose readings during brief signal gaps. Added proactive 2-hour session
  refresh, duplicate reading detection, and immediate retry after re-auth.

  New: Login success overlay, legal disclaimer with "Don't show again" (NVS-backed), WiFi disconnected overlay, hold-to-confirm power off and WiFi removal.

  UI: Glucose chart redesign (1/3/6/12/24h ranges, target band, per-segment coloring), alarm and snooze visual overhaul, Dexcom login facelift, weather settings rewrite, battery HSV color
   gradient.

  Performance: CPU 160→240MHz, nano printf, mbedTLS stripped (TLS client only, 9 unused ECP curves removed, common cert bundle), binary reduced 1.57→1.37MB.

  Fixes: WiFi NVS corruption (contiguous packing bug), settings screen crash (LVGL pool exhaustion), weather task stack overflow, alarm inactivity timer infinite loop, WiFi password eye
  toggle UAF, screen transition crashes, WiFi auto-reconnect during network switching.

  Battery: Trend-based charging detection, 8-sample rolling average, charging voltage curve, ±2% step clamping.

  SD Logger v2: Mount-on-write, 8KB serial capture buffer, OOM resilience, 60-second periodic flush.
